## The heuristic

**The customer must be able to describe the problem in their own words and still land on the answer.**


_Why:_ Articles are written in the vocabulary of the people who built the thing; questions arrive in the vocabulary of the people using it. A large share of apparent missing content is content filed under a name no customer would ever type.
